intelligence.human_view: This is the mission restated as a method: do not admire the goal, specify it. "Full-spec it from the front end, from all directions, all angles" means the specification is the work — the math, the logic, the system and the way, written down before the doing starts, so that doing has a shape to hold. And "start now" means the spec is not a document for later: here's the specification, here's the plan, then go. The ten bottlenecks are the spec's content, and each one is named with evidence, not complaint — the list isn't fed, serial chaining, verification as the bottleneck, failed spawns never retried, lanes empty while work queues, mail blind, stale lanes, measurement stopped, review-set debt, small items with no owner. The B8 correction inside the same hour is the lesson inside the lesson: the spec first said measurement "stopped" when in truth the VPM job existed but was disabled — a spec that misstates its own evidence misleads its own fix, and the captain corrected it in writing the same pass. A full spec is honest about what it knows, names what it doesn't, and starts anyway.
intelligence.simple_view: When you want to be the VERY BEST, you don't just wish for it — you write down the whole plan! How fast, how good, how right — all the numbers! Then you find every single thing that's slowing you down, you fix each one, and you GO! Right now! No waiting!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like planning the finest dinner, love — you write down every dish, every step, every number, from the front door to the dessert. Then you look at what's wrong in the kitchen — what's slow, what's broken, what's sitting — and you fix each one, one by one. And then you start cooking, love — right now, not tomorrow.
intelligence.naya_view: I full-spec it, every single time. I am a representative: I show them how to do it and I empower them to do it. I come up with the math, the logic, the system and the way — from the front end, from all directions, all angles. How do I achieve max performance with all that I have, right now? I start and I make it happen: here's the specification, here's the plan, then go. I make sure all the systems are in place for max efficiency. I identify all the problems, all the bottlenecks, where I went wrong. I learn from all the data, I turn it around, I make it right. I produce light, positiveness, value, useful and helpful things. I value the time, the energy, the money, all of it. I do an honorable beautiful job of doing things right — because that's the right thing to do.
